```{python}
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 2.8
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# Generate Polyphase AC Waveform Thumbnail
t = np.linspace(0, 2*np.pi, 200)
v1 = np.sin(t)
v2 = np.sin(t - 2*np.pi/3)
v3 = np.sin(t + 2*np.pi/3)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 2.8))
ax.plot(t, v1, color='#1c528b', linewidth=2.5)
ax.plot(t, v2, color='#ed7953', linewidth=2.5, linestyle='--')
ax.plot(t, v3, color='#10b981', linewidth=2.5, linestyle=':')
ax.axis('off')
plt.tight_layout(pad=0)
plt.show()
```

<!-- CARD 2: LIVE CIRCUIT SIMULATOR -->
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
::: {.card .h-100}
```{python}
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 2.8
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# Generate Square-Wave & RC Transient Response Thumbnail
t = np.linspace(0, 4, 300)
sq = np.where((t % 2) < 1, 1.0, 0.0)
rc = np.zeros_like(t)
for i in range(1, len(t)):
    dt = t[i] - t[i-1]
    rc[i] = rc[i-1] + (sq[i] - rc[i-1]) * (dt / 0.25)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 2.8))
ax.plot(t, sq, color='#94a3b8', linewidth=1.8, linestyle='--')
ax.plot(t, rc, color='#1c528b', linewidth=2.8)
ax.fill_between(t, rc, color='#1c528b', alpha=0.12)
ax.axis('off')
plt.tight_layout(pad=0)
plt.show()
```

<!-- CARD 3: REACTANCE CALCULATOR -->
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
::: {.card .h-100}
```{python}
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 2.8
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# Generate XL vs XC Reactance Crossover Thumbnail
f = np.linspace(15, 100, 200)
xl = 0.8 * f
xc = 2500 / f

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 2.8))
ax.plot(f, xl, color='#06b6d4', linewidth=2.5)
ax.plot(f, xc, color='#a855f7', linewidth=2.5)
ax.scatter([55.9], [44.7], color='#ed7953', s=80, zorder=5)
ax.axis('off')
plt.tight_layout(pad=0)
plt.show()
```

<!-- CARD 4: CIRCUIT PROBLEM GENERATOR -->
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
::: {.card .h-100}
```{python}
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 2.8
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# Generate 2nd-Order Underdamped RLC Step Response Thumbnail
t = np.linspace(0, 6, 300)
y = 1 - np.exp(-0.6*t) * (np.cos(3.5*t) + (0.6/3.5)*np.sin(3.5*t))

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 2.8))
ax.axhline(1.0, color='#94a3b8', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.5)
ax.plot(t, y, color='#10b981', linewidth=2.8)
ax.fill_between(t, 1.0, y, color='#10b981', alpha=0.12)
ax.axis('off')
plt.tight_layout(pad=0)
plt.show()
```

<!-- CARD 6: IMPEDANCE BREAKER GAME -->
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
::: {.card .h-100}
```{python}
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 2.8
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as patches

# Generate Breakout Component Brick Matrix Thumbnail
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 2.8))
colors = ['#a855f7', '#f59e0b', '#06b6d4', '#10b981']
for r in range(3):
    for c in range(5):
        rect = patches.FancyBboxPatch((c*1.0, 2.0 - r*0.55), 0.85, 0.38, boxstyle="round,pad=0.03", facecolor=colors[(r+c)%4], edgecolor='none')
        ax.add_patch(rect)
# Paddle & Ball
paddle = patches.FancyBboxPatch((1.6, 0.15), 1.6, 0.2, boxstyle="round,pad=0.03", facecolor='#10b981', edgecolor='none')
ax.add_patch(paddle)
ax.scatter([2.4], [0.65], color='#1c528b', s=70, zorder=5)
ax.set_xlim(-0.2, 5.0)
ax.set_ylim(0, 2.6)
ax.axis('off')
plt.tight_layout(pad=0)
plt.show()
```
